scope: Fixed crossing event, matched feature families, separate risk and execution; a bounded development experiment, not an untouched historical holdout

event.geometry: Native BB M1/M3/M6: nineteen completed closes plus developing quote, sample standard deviation, three lines per scale
event.query: The first future crossing of each of nine lines strictly after delayed entry; later recross cannot replace a first failed crossing
event.reference: R_event=max(2*(decision spread+0.30),0.10*BB1 halfwidth,0.50); G_event=2*R_event; H=300 seconds
event.unknown: Common full maturity of all nine cells; unresolved support loss is UNKNOWN, never a negative
event.ids: Geometry/source-bound physical crossing IDs retained in bank, map and first-qualifying label fields; no future IDs enter X

loss.formula: BCE(z_event,1[y>0]) + 1[y>0]*CE(z_direction,y-1), averaged over common known roots
loss.weights: Uniform origins. Conditional direction is not gated by predicted event confidence. Crossing IDs are retained but do not yet change training weights.
loss.gradient: Unreduced actual dL_i/dz_i is stored; E/L/S temporal indicator differences and shared-encoder gradient cosine are separate diagnostics
loss.focal: gamma=0 baseline. Do not suppress easy examples until gradient mass and event multiplicity identify a specific imbalance problem. No claim that focal is superior.

risk_execution.gain: G_event is fixed across plans, so enlarging the stop does not silently change the event label
risk_execution.exit: First qualifying first-line crossing, STOP, or exact entry+300s timer; TIME wins a same-clock crossing; exit latency still applies
risk_execution.entry: First supported full-quote publication strictly after decision+100ms, pending timeout 2s
risk_execution.money: USD per reference ounce, executable BBO and assumed 0.30 roundtrip fee; no depth, queue, size-impact or live-fill claim
risk_execution.account: One position, full prediction clock, no future-label filter; CENSORED halts the account; closed cash is not mark-to-market equity
risk_execution.interpretation: P(side crossing) is not calibrated P(success under a particular stop). Paired true-event retention is an oracle diagnostic, not model profit.

hyperparameters.sequence: 64 roots at 5s; four-layer TCN with two kernel-3 convolutions per block has RF61=300s. MLP sees only the current token. This compares architecture and history together.
hyperparameters.context: Current/previous London summaries and 128-completed-M1 spectral summaries; long paths are compressed. VWAP context is a midpoint/volume proxy, not exact new-session trade-price VWAP.
hyperparameters.capacity: Hidden width32, dropout0.05; fixed across feature families, so parameter count increases with input dimension. Not an equal-parameter architecture contest.
hyperparameters.optimizer: AdamW learning rate0.001, weight decay0.0001, batch256, gradient norm cap1.0; actual gradient clipping fraction is recorded
hyperparameters.budget: At most1500 optimizer updates, approximately2.5 passes over admitted TRAIN roots; validation every150, patience5. This is a bounded baseline, not a converged hyperparameter search.
hyperparameters.sampling: Uniform-root permutation cycles; 5s origins overlap heavily over a300s target horizon. Root count is not independent sample count.
hyperparameters.normalization: One shared TRAIN-only scaler, independent of label maturity; log transforms for heavy-tailed counts/depth/power, cap10 standard deviations, explicit per-feature missingness and real-row masks

selection.checkpoint_and_family: VAL joint NLL selects checkpoint and one of six seed17 architecture/family combinations
selection.replication: Selected architecture/family is fitted at prespecified seed29; seed17 remains primary, no test-selected seed winner
selection.policy: CAL selects one of three risks and five thresholds, requiring completed positive net and at least50 trades; otherwise WAIT
selection.test: Two weeks, ten sessions, are evaluated without retuning; all development TEST diagnostics are saved, so this is not a technically sealed blind test
selection.uncertainty: Use day-level paired summaries/bootstrap, not independent-root confidence intervals; ten days still limit precision
